args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: From the deployment history, v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy release. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was only staging).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed with status "rolled_out".

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action taken.

5. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
